mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (user_email, user_pw, nickname, gender, role, phone_number, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userEmail}, #{userPw}, #{nickname}, #{gender}, #{role}, #{phoneNumber}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT user_no, user_email, user_pw, nickname, user_img, created_at, updated_at, gender, role, phone_number FROM user WHERE user_email = #{userEmail}
SELECT user_no, user_email, user_pw, nickname, user_img, created_at, updated_at, gender, role, phone_number FROM user WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET user_pw = #{userPw}, nickname = #{nickname}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_no = #{userNo}

UPDATE menu m JOIN ( SELECT i.menu_id, SUM(i.menu_rating) AS rating_sum, COUNT(*) AS img_count FROM sns_board_image i JOIN sns_board b ON b.board_id = i.board_id WHERE b.user_no = #{userNo} GROUP BY i.menu_id ) AS img ON m.menu_id = img.menu_id SET m.total_rating = GREATEST(m.total_rating - img.rating_sum, 0), m.review_count = GREATEST(m.review_count - img.img_count, 0);

UPDATE restaurants r JOIN ( SELECT b.restaurant_id, COALESCE(SUM(i.menu_rating), 0) AS rating_sum, COUNT(i.image_id) AS image_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.board_id) AS board_count FROM sns_board b LEFT JOIN sns_board_image i ON b.board_id = i.board_id WHERE b.user_no = #{userNo} GROUP BY b.restaurant_id ) AS x ON r.restaurant_id = x.restaurant_id SET r.total_rating = GREATEST(r.total_rating - x.rating_sum, 0), r.total_contents = GREATEST(r.total_contents - x.board_count, 0), r.review_counts = GREATEST(r.review_counts - x.image_count, 0);
mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.nickname, u.user_img AS userImg, u.gender, u.created_at AS createdAt,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow WHERE following_no = u.user_no) AS followerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow WHERE follower_no = u.user_no) AS followingCount,
EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM follow WHERE follower_no = #{myUserNo} AND following_no = u.user_no ) AS isFollowing,
EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM follow WHERE follower_no = u.user_no AND following_no = #{myUserNo} ) AS isFollower,
( SELECT follow_id FROM follow WHERE follower_no = #{myUserNo} AND following_no = u.user_no ) AS followId,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sns_board WHERE user_no = u.user_no) AS postCount,
CASE WHEN u.user_no = #{myUserNo} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isMyProfile,
r.restaurant_id AS restaurantId
FROM user u LEFT JOIN restaurants r ON r.user_no = u.user_no WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo}

SELECT u.user_no, u.user_email, u.nickname, u.created_at, u.role, u.user_img, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM follow WHERE following_no = u.user_no) AS followerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sns_board WHERE user_no = u.user_no) AS reviewCount FROM user u;
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET user_img = #{userImg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
